kitDescription: Centi is an Iron rocket-launcher Defender whose job is keeping the team alive rather than dealing damage. At the start of battle she immediately casts her Skill 2, which puts a shared shield equal to 7% of her max HP on all allies for 5 seconds, and every full-charge shot she lands shaves time off Skill 2's cooldown so the shield comes back faster. If her shield is broken by enemy damage, the whole team is healed for 9.7% of her max HP. Her Burst II hits the 5 lowest-HP enemies for 145.46% of her ATK, lowers their DEF by 14.54% for 10 seconds, and raises her own max HP by 5% for 10 seconds. In a boss fight her offensive contribution is the burst nuke plus the team-wide damage gain from the DEF debuff.

verdictRationale: No real gotchas: all five non-burst-damage lines are deliberately UNMODELED with verbatim prose and sound scope-lock inertness arguments (shields, shield-CD, shield-break heal, and self Max HP all touch no outgoing-damage bucket for centi), and the two offensively live burst lines are FAITHFUL — the 145.46% nuke is burstCast-keyed so it correctly never takes the FB major, and the DEF debuff rides the enemy defPct channel (mica precedent) with the damageTakenPct-laundering counterfactual explicitly discriminated and shown to move team totals differently. The blind re-derivations converged where it matters: S5's 7 reds decompose into its own fixture vacuity (crown B2 steals every stage-2 slot, so its burst assertions could never observe centi) plus assertions of lines the driver documented as gaps — i.e., zero undocumented divergences; S6 agreed on the burst nuke, and its one substantive dissent (DEF debuff 'cannot be modeled') is a blind misread of the engine's stat vocabulary, a RECON_ERROR in the driver's favor, while its attempt to model the shield lines required an invented 15s interval that contradicts the datamined 9s Skill 2 cooldown in the ground truth — retroactively validating the driver's gap decision. The same-model residual the owner should spot-check: the 'shields are inert' ruling is fixture-true but comp-false — in a real tandem comp with a shielded/recovery-trigger consumer (Crown-style), centi's unmodeled shield and heal lines would under-credit that teammate's procs, so if centi is ever benched into a consumer comp the tandem gap becomes live; also confirm the burst DEF debuff's bossDefNow routing against the mica pin one more time, since both the driver and this judge leaned on that single precedent.
